items.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
items.summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

items.title: Osmosis Ends OSMO Inflation, Shifting Staking Rewards to Revenue
items.summary: The change removes an estimated two percentage points of issuance-funded staking APR and freezes about 51.9 million pre-minted developer tokens.

items.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

items.title: CZ pitches BNB Chain’s role in AI as BNB Standard rings Nasdaq bell
items.summary: CZ sees AI driving crypto use, while BNB Standard plans to expand beyond holding tokens in its treasury.
